steps.do:
Read docs/features/${input.featureCode}/blueprint.md including its Boundary
Map. Decompose it into independent tasks.

MUST checklist:
- Every task must identify id, description, files_owned, files_read, and
  depends_on.
- Every task's files_owned MUST include every test file that task will create
  or modify, because the implementer is required to write tests and may not
  touch unowned paths.
- A task that legitimately writes no test MUST say why in its description.
- Reject file ownership conflicts: files_owned MUST remain pairwise disjoint
  across tasks. Redo the decomposition if ownership overlaps.
- Put the matching produces/consumes entries, verbatim Boundary Map slice,
  upstream summaries, and required pre-merge commands
  ${input.pre_merge_gate} into description.
- Each slice maps to exactly one task and its File Plan is owned by that task.
Return {tasks}.

Implement the task described by ${item} using TDD. Honor its id, files_owned, files_read, depends_on, and description fields. Write the TaskResult JSON under .compose/gsd/${input.featureCode}/results/ using the task id as its filename, and include it in your diff. Return {outcome, summary, files_changed}.

Final verification and ship for ${input.featureCode}. Run all gate commands ${input.gateCommands}; fix failures. Update ROADMAP.md and CHANGELOG.md, update CLAUDE.md only for a new convention, stage only GSD-produced files, and commit with message "feat(COMP-GSD-2): per-task fresh-context dispatch". Do not push. Return PhaseResult with files_changed and commit_hash.
